name: How does the payment process work for a pre-construction home?

mainEntity.name: How does the payment process work for a pre-construction home?

acceptedAnswer.text: The payment process typically involves an initial deposit, followed by a series of payments at various construction milestones. The total deposit amount and payment schedule are outlined in the purchase agreement. These deposits are usually held in an escrow account until closing. It's crucial to understand the builder's specific deposit structure and payment deadlines, as these can vary. Your real estate agent will help you navigate these financial stages and ensure you understand each contractual obligation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Payments for pre-construction homes usually involve an initial deposit and subsequent payments tied to construction milestones.
